# gardience_machine (Resource)

A machine's membership in the Gardience fleet. Create it next to the instance Terraform builds: it waits until the machine has joined (so later resources can rely on it being managed), and when the instance is destroyed it removes the machine from Gardience, so the fleet never fills with dead machines.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Wait until web-1 has joined; when it is destroyed, remove it from the fleet.
resource "gardience_machine" "web1" {
  name         = "web-1"
  join_timeout = "20m"
  depends_on   = [aws_instance.web1]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The machine's name in Gardience (the `node` given to `gardience_bootstrap_script`, or its host name).

### Optional

- `join_timeout` (String) How long to wait, as a duration such as `20m`.
- `remove_on_destroy` (Boolean) Remove the machine from Gardience when this resource is destroyed. Default true.
- `wait_for_join` (Boolean) Wait until the machine has joined. Default true.

### Read-Only

- `key` (String) The machine's key state: accepted, pending, rejected, denied or none.
- `os` (String) Operating system, once Gardience has scanned it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import gardience_machine.web1 web-1
```
